name: People's Public Security University of China

evidence.summary: PPSUC, in Beijing, describes itself as a university run directly by China’s Ministry of Public Security and the ministry’s senior police officers’ college. Founded in 1948 as a Communist Party security cadre training class, it trains police at every degree level in subjects including political security protection, counter-terrorism policing and data policing, runs a national security college and a military security college that trains military security cadres, and hosts national engineering laboratories for computer virus prevention and for big-data social risk monitoring.
